tool_schemas.name: parse-swagger
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the Swagger/OpenAPI document at `url`, parses it, and returns an operation index (optionally including schema definitions via `includeSchemas` and full request/response detail via `includeDetails`). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` when `url` is missing/invalid or `headers` is not an object of strings, `NOT_FOUND` when the document cannot be retrieved from the given URL, and `PARSE_ERROR` when the retrieved content is not a supported or parseable Swagger/OpenAPI document.

includeDetails.description: Whether to include all details like request bodies, responses, etc.

tool_schemas.name: parse-swagger-optimized
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and parses the Swagger/OpenAPI document at `url` using an optimized parser and can return a filtered operation index (by `filterTag` and/or `pathPrefix`), with optional schema/detail expansion and optional caching (`useCache`, `cacheTTLMinutes`) and lazy schema parsing (`lazyLoading`). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid inputs (including non-positive `cacheTTLMinutes` when provided), `NOT_FOUND` when the document cannot be retrieved, and `PARSE_ERROR` when the document is not parseable; when `skipValidation` is false it also raises `SPEC_VALIDATION_ERROR` for non-compliant specs that fail validation.

includeDetails.description: Whether to include all details like request bodies, responses, etc.

skipValidation.description: Whether to skip validation, used for handling non-fully compliant API documents

lazyLoading.description: Whether to use lazy loading for schema parsing

tool_schemas.name: parse-swagger-lite
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and performs lightweight parsing of the Swagger/OpenAPI document at `url` and returns a basic operation index suitable for large documents, with optional filtering (`filterTag`, `pathPrefix`), caching (`useCache`, `cacheTTLMinutes`), and lazy loading (`lazyLoading`). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid inputs (including non-positive `cacheTTLMinutes` when provided), `NOT_FOUND` when the document cannot be retrieved, and `PARSE_ERROR` when the document is not parseable; when `skipValidation` is false it raises `SPEC_VALIDATION_ERROR` if the spec fails validation.

includeDetails.description: Whether to include all details like request bodies, responses, etc.

skipValidation.description: Whether to skip validation, used for handling non-fully compliant API documents

lazyLoading.description: Whether to use lazy loading for schema parsing

tool_schemas.name: generate-typescript-types
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and parses the Swagger/OpenAPI document at `swaggerUrl`, generates TypeScript type definitions using the provided options (namespace/enums/strictness/include/exclude/index naming), writes outputs under `outputDir`, and returns a generation result that includes the produced file set. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid inputs (including invalid include/exclude lists or non-positive `cacheTTLMinutes` when provided), `NOT_FOUND` when the spec cannot be retrieved, `SPEC_VALIDATION_ERROR` when `skipValidation` is false and the spec is invalid, and `CONFLICT` when `overwrite` is false and generation would replace existing output files.

useNamespace.description: Whether to use namespace for wrapping types

excludeSchemas.description: Array of schema names to exclude

includeSchemas.description: Array of schema names to include

generateIndex.description: Whether to generate an index file

tool_schemas.name: generate-typescript-types-optimized
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and parses the Swagger/OpenAPI document at `swaggerUrl` with optimized support for caching (`useCache`, `cacheTTLMinutes`) and large specs (`lazyLoading`), generates TypeScript type definitions, writes outputs under `outputDir`, and returns a generation result that includes the produced file set. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid inputs (including non-positive `cacheTTLMinutes` when provided), `NOT_FOUND` when the spec cannot be retrieved, `SPEC_VALIDATION_ERROR` when `skipValidation` is false and the spec is invalid, and `CONFLICT` when `overwrite` is false and generation would replace existing output files.

useNamespace.description: Whether to use namespace for wrapping types

excludeSchemas.description: Array of schema names to exclude

includeSchemas.description: Array of schema names to include

generateIndex.description: Whether to generate an index file

tool_schemas.name: generate-api-client
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and parses the Swagger/OpenAPI document at `swaggerUrl`, generates client code for the selected `clientType` (axios/fetch/react-query) with optional grouping and tag filters, writes outputs under `outputDir`, and returns a generation result that includes the produced file set. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid inputs (including unsupported `clientType`, invalid `groupBy`, or invalid include/exclude tag filters), `NOT_FOUND` when the spec cannot be retrieved, `SPEC_VALIDATION_ERROR` when the spec is invalid, and `CONFLICT` when `overwrite` is false and generation would replace existing output files.

tool_schemas.name: generate-api-client-optimized
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and parses the Swagger/OpenAPI document at `swaggerUrl` using optimized parsing options, generates client code for the selected `clientType` with optional grouping and tag filters, writes outputs under `outputDir`, and returns a generation result that includes the produced file set. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid inputs (including unsupported `clientType` or invalid filters), `NOT_FOUND` when the spec cannot be retrieved, `SPEC_VALIDATION_ERROR` when the spec is invalid, and `CONFLICT` when `overwrite` is false and generation would replace existing output files.

tool_schemas.name: file_writer
tool_schemas.description: Write content to the specified file path, with support for automatic directory creation

content.description: Content to be written to the file

createDirs.description: Whether to automatically create parent directories if they do not exist

append.description: Whether to append to an existing file instead of overwriting it

tool_schemas.name: template-list
tool_schemas.description: Get available code generation template list

framework.description: Framework type filter (only for API client and config file templates)

tool_schemas.name: template-get
template-save
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new custom template or updates an existing one with the provided id, returning the saved template record (including its type/framework metadata and content). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, unknown fields are provided, type is not one of the supported values, or framework is provided when not applicable or is not a supported framework. Raises CONFLICT if a template cannot be updated due to an incompatible existing template type/framework for the same id, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to manage templates.

framework.description: Framework type (only for API client and config file templates)

tool_schemas.name: template-delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the custom template identified by id and returns a confirmation of deletion. Raises NOT_FOUND if no template exists for the given id. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to manage templates, and CONFLICT if the template cannot be deleted because it is currently referenced by an active generation job or configured as in-use by the system.

tool_schemas.name: document-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists ingested OpenAPI documents with optional filtering and pagination. Returns document metadata (never parses) and refuses invalid pagination or unknown status values with `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

url.description: Filter by exact original URL match.

urlNormalized.description: Filter by exact normalized URL match.

contentSha256.description: Filter by exact content SHA-256 hash.

includeDeleted.description: When true, include rows with status='deleted' (otherwise excluded by default).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: document-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single ingested OpenAPI document by `id`. Returns document metadata and cached fetch info, and refuses unknown ids with `NOT_FOUND`.

includeBody.description: When true, include cached `raw_body`/`raw_bytes` when available; otherwise omitted to reduce payload size.

tool_schemas.name: document-refresh
tool_schemas.description: Forces a refetch of a previously ingested OpenAPI document (by `id`), transitioning status to `fetching` and then to `active`/`failed`. Respects `useCache` and `cacheTTLMinutes` the same way as parse tools and refuses invalid transitions or missing ids with `NOT_FOUND`/`VALIDATION_ERROR`.

headers.description: Request headers to use for the refetch (e.g., Authorization, If-None-Match).

useCache.description: Whether to reuse cached content when still fresh.

cacheTTLMinutes.description: If provided, sets cache expiry to now + TTL minutes.

tool_schemas.name: parse-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a previously created parse record by `id`, including derived artifacts (operation index and optional schemas blob depending on the original parse options). Refuses unknown ids with `NOT_FOUND`.

tool_schemas.name: job-cancel
tool_schemas.description: Cancels a queued or running code generation job, transitioning status to `cancelled`. Refuses cancellation for terminal jobs (`succeeded`,`failed`,`cancelled`) with `INVALID_STATE` and unknown ids with `NOT_FOUND`.

metadata.name: Swagger MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores ingested Swagger/OpenAPI documents (including cached fetches) and derived artifacts: parsed operation indexes, generated code outputs, and reusable code-generation templates. Main workflows are: (1) fetch+parse an OpenAPI document (optionally cached/filtered) and return operation
